GIN.note: Document is about client protection in inclusive finance; nothing on e-procurement.
Document says the BCRG supervises inclusive financial institutions but does not state it licenses payment providers or oversees a switch.

facts.fact: The article by lawyer Me Fode Mourana Soumah says the BCRG adopted instruction I/DGSIF/DSIMF/006/2018 setting consumer-protection standards for inclusive financial institutions, which include e-money institutions, requiring displayed fees, written contracts, plain language and client data access.

GIN.note: Nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: The article says law L/2017/031/AN of 4 July 2017 on Inclusive Financial Institutions defines licensed institutions, including e-money institutions (EME), serving people outside the traditional banking circuit.
facts.system: Law L/2017/031/AN on Institutions Financieres Inclusives

facts.fact: The article says the 2017 law counts licensed e-money institutions (EME), microfinance institutions and postal financial services as inclusive financial institutions.
facts.system: Law L/2017/031/AN on Institutions Financieres Inclusives

GIN.note: No survey figure on account holding.
E-money institutions are named only as a category; no service in operation is stated.
Nothing on tax or fee payment.
